primary_question: Do independently trained organ experts express reproducible gene-level functional correction programs that are stronger than generic and random-partition controls?

rationale.trigger: The seed-factorized directed-transfer diagnosis found 0/8 stable-helpful additive edges and 6/8 unstable or negligible edges.
rationale.stopped_primary_track: Raw organ-to-organ data addition is no longer the main Stage 2 discovery strategy.
rationale.preserved_evidence: The Stage 1 organ-expert reconstruction result remains the validated benchmark; the preliminary directed-transfer heatmap remains descriptive development evidence only.
rationale.pivot: Measure stable functional representations first, then test prospectively whether those representations predict safe sharing.

frozen_estimands.specialist_efficacy_vs_pooled: per-gene squared error of pooled trunk minus the named organ expert
frozen_estimands.specialist_efficacy_vs_generic_adapter: per-gene squared error of pooled adapter minus the named organ expert
frozen_estimands.semantic_specificity_vs_random: mean per-gene squared error of three manifest-assigned random experts minus the named organ expert
frozen_estimands.functional_correction: named organ-expert prediction minus pooled-adapter prediction
frozen_estimands.random_functional_correction: mean manifest-assigned random-expert prediction minus pooled-adapter prediction
frozen_estimands.aggregation: samples are averaged within donor and organ before donors receive equal weight
frozen_estimands.seed_policy: all three seeds are reported; no best-seed or best-organ selection

functional_correction: minimum pairwise top-100 absolute-gene Jaccard overlap
reproducibility_metrics.uncertainty: two-sided donor bootstrap over the three-seed mean donor effect
reproducibility_metrics.candidate_stable_gene_rule: same nonzero efficacy-vs-generic sign in all three seeds, 99% donor-bootstrap interval excluding zero, and 99% semantic-specificity interval above zero
reproducibility_metrics.candidate_gene_scope: exploratory mechanism candidates, not multiplicity-controlled gene discoveries

decision_rule.representation_first_success: at least 4 of 8 organs pass every organ representation gate
decision_rule.partial_signal: 1 to 3 organs pass; retain only those as hypotheses and broaden the attribute audit before any sharing implementation
decision_rule.organ_axis_insufficient: zero organs pass; pivot from organ-only structure to a frozen multi-attribute audit using tissue site and other available outcome-independent metadata
decision_rule.next_experiment_after_success: freeze a prospective predictor mapping expert-signature similarity to recipient-protected sharing decisions, then test on untouched schedules or studies
decision_rule.forbidden_inference: signature similarity alone is not evidence that training data should be shared

implementation_binding.rule: The launcher requires a clean full Git commit and records that exact commit plus this protocol SHA256 in every output.
